summary: Iteration 11 (Face-recognition attendance kiosk) — 33 new backend tests + regression pass (iter9 role-gating + iter10 meeting-time). 62/62 green. Frontend UI verified: shift-panel visible for all admins, kiosk-panel super_admin-only, kiosk URL generation + copy work, /kiosk/scan gates by token, Employees edit dialog exposes face-enroll-section.

minor.issue: Because Pydantic's exclude_none=True is used, callers cannot CLEAR an employee-level shift override (i.e. push it back to fall-through to department/company). Only overwrite with another value is possible. Consider accepting an explicit '__reset__' or supporting nullable via a separate DELETE-style endpoint.

Endpoint validation ordering: FaceEnrollBody.embeddings has Field(min_length=3) which returns 422; if the client sends 3+ embeddings but each of wrong length, face_service returns 400 with '128 floats' message. Both paths are handled by tests, but the docstring/spec asks for 400 in all cases — worth normalising to 400 for a clean UX.

notify_checkin_checkout defaults to events_enabled.checkin_checkout=false in DEFAULT_EVENTS_ENABLED, so kiosk checkins do NOT push WhatsApp until an admin explicitly toggles it on. Fine, but iter11 spec implies the notification should fire — either flip the default to true or surface a UI hint.

integration_issues.issue: shift_start_time & late_grace_minutes are accepted by the API and covered by backend tests, but the Employees edit UI does NOT expose these fields. HR/admins currently have no way to set an employee-level override from the UI — they have to use PATCH /api/employees/{id} directly.

issues: Missing shift override inputs — see integration_issues above.

action_items: Add shift_start_time + late_grace_minutes inputs to the Employees Edit dialog (per-employee override UI). Backend already supports it (iter11 tests verify).
Consider defaulting whatsapp_configs.events_enabled.checkin_checkout to true so kiosk check-ins actually push notifications out-of-the-box (currently disabled in seed defaults).
Consider offering a 'clear override' affordance on PATCH /employees/{id} so admins can drop an employee shift override back to the department/company default (today exclude_none prevents it).
critical_code_review_comments: face_service.py: solid separation of validation, storage, matching. Euclidean threshold 0.55 on L2-normalised 128-d vectors is a reasonable default (matches @vladmandic/human docs).

face_service.py._validate_embedding correctly rejects NaN/Infinity but also accepts Python bool subclass of int; a stray True/False slipping through will be treated as 1.0/0.0 — probably fine but flag if strictness matters.

routes/kiosk.py: /match reads embeddings from all active employees every call; for tenants with >500 enrolled employees this is O(N·128) each request. Fine for typical office kiosk, but consider caching or FAISS/HNSW if scaling beyond a few thousand.

routes/kiosk.py._perform_check_out duration calc has a subtle bug: datetime.fromisoformat(now) has no tzinfo (isoformat with '+00:00' does), then `.replace(tzinfo=utc)` — but the ternary `if check_in_dt.tzinfo else 0` will return 0 when the STORED check_in has no tzinfo. On UTC-normalised stores this is fine, but it silently drops duration to 0 for legacy records. Consider always parsing both and using astimezone.

routes/companies.py.get_kiosk_token returns the RAW token (not masked) — comment claims it should mask but code returns full. Given endpoint is super_admin-only, this is intentional but the docstring above is misleading.
routes/employees.py.update_employee uses exclude_none=True — as noted, this prevents clearing an override.
routes/attendance.py.check-in stores shift_start_time + shift_source on the attendance doc — great for audit trail.
seed defaults: DEFAULT_EVENTS_ENABLED['checkin_checkout']=False means kiosk notifications silently drop. Recommend enabling by default OR surfacing a warning in the kiosk-panel UI.
seed_data_creation: None permanent. Test file creates TEST_kiosk_* employees inside a class fixture and DELETEs them; a final cleanup pass deleted 3 leftover TEST_ employees from a prior failed run. Company shift restored to 09:30/15/kiosk_enabled=true. Maya's face enrollment deleted, employee override reset to 09:30/15. WhatsApp events_enabled restored to original values.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_face_kiosk.py is standalone (needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var). It reserves the class fixture kiosk_token for match tests to avoid rotate-invalidation races. TestKioskCheckInOut.test_check_in_and_out temporarily flips whatsapp_configs.events_enabled.checkin_checkout=true and restores it in a finally block. Because Maya may already be checked in when this suite runs, the check-in test tolerates both 200 (fresh) and 400 (duplicate) — outbox assertion only runs when at least one fresh event occurred. Company state is left at shift_start_time=09:30, late_grace_minutes=15, kiosk_enabled=true. Maya's face enrollment is deleted at teardown.
rca of the issue: N/A — iter11 shipped cleanly. During test authoring, my first outbox-row assertion failed because whatsapp_configs.events_enabled.checkin_checkout defaults to false in DEFAULT_EVENTS_ENABLED (whatsapp_service.py:38). Fixed by having the test temporarily flip the event on before checking the outbox and restore the original config after. This is documented as a minor issue for the main agent to consider (either flip default or add UI hint).
